ja: その一言[ひとこと]が国[くに]を揺[ゆ]るがす
en: that single word shakes the whole country; yurugasu means to shake.

ja: この結果[けっか]を覆[くつがえ]すのは無理[むり]だ
en: overturning this result is impossible; kutsugaesu means to overturn.

ja: 俺[おれ]はあの男[おとこ]を告発[こくはつ]するつもりだ
en: I intend to denounce that man; kokuhatsu suru means to accuse publicly.

ja: 人[ひと]の記憶[きおく]を操作[そうさ]する術[じゅつ]があるらしい
en: apparently there is an art that manipulates memory; sousa suru means to manipulate.
